## Summary
- describe the change

## Verification
- list the checks you ran

## Title Format
Use one of these prefixes so merges to `main` can drive semantic versioning:

- `major: short summary`
- `minor: short summary`
- `patch: short summary`

Examples:
- `major: redesign stored distance data model`
- `minor: add BeamNG debug telemetry support`
- `patch: fix iRacing transient zero-drop handling`
